items.title: Critical Vulnerability In Flowise Allows Remote Command Execution Via MCP Adapters
items.description: A critical vulnerability in Flowise and multiple AI frameworks has been discovered by OX Security, exposing millions of users to remote code execution (RCE). The flaw stems from the Model Context Protocol (MCP), a widely used communication standard for AI agents developed by Anthropic. items.title: Vercel Breach Tied to Context AI Hack Exposes Limited Customer Credentials
items.description: Web infrastructure provider Vercel has disclosed a security breach that allows bad actors to gain unauthorized access to "certain" internal Vercel systems.
